shortDescription: Enbridge TSX:ENB is in advanced talks to buy a major crude oil pipeline in the U.S. from Blackstone-owned NYSE:BX Tallgrass Energy for about $2 billion, Bloomberg News reported on Wednesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
